text: You have an order sent to Texas by accident, and you want to know the tracking number of the order, and return all items in it except the pet bed. You don't remember the order number. It is urgent.
zh: 您不小心把订单寄到了德克萨斯州，想查询订单的追踪号，并且想退回订单中的所有商品，除了宠物床。您不记得订单号了。很紧急。(#W1234567, 商品id: XXX, 产品名: 宠物床)
